title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选以预印本、机构公开帖文和开源软件项目为主，未见以同行评议论文身份入选的条目。化学与生物频道聚焦 AI 驱动的药物设计、扰动组学和临床前后相关证据；AI Voices 提供科学智能体与模型安全的公开观点；工程频道则呈现可审计安全审计、语音与视觉工具的社区热度。AI×Math 今日没有足够高质量更新。

channel_highlights.aixchem: 三项均为预印本：重点是 AI 辅助优化靶向 MsbA 的抗菌小分子，摘要报告了小鼠感染模型和机制实验，结论仍待同行评议与复现。
channel_highlights.aixbio: 三项均为预印本：IGNITE 以原代 CD4+ T 细胞扰动数据辅助免疫靶点排序；狂犬病疫苗 III 期结果虽具临床相关性，仍非同行评议结论。
channel_highlights.aixmath: AI×Math 今日没有足够高质量更新，未列出精选条目，也没有可据此报道的同行评议论文或预印本。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 均为机构公开帖文而非论文：ScienceBuddy 报告科学智能体训练结果，OpenAI 披露失配事件框架；相关指标与主张仍应以独立材料核验。
channel_highlights.engineering: 入选的是 GitHub Trending 开源软件项目，并非软件正式发布：Cloudflare 的安全审计技能强调机器可读发现，Voicebox 与 Supervision 分别聚焦语音和视觉工程。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Periodic Labs 报告 Neon 将困难 X 射线衍射分析成功率提升约二十倍
breaking_news.summary_zh: Periodic Labs 团队在公开帖文中报告，Neon 经实验室数据、中期训练与强化学习后，在 134 个困难 X 射线衍射样品上的分析成功率由 2.7% 升至 55.3%；结果由与人类专家校准的模型评审。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 若该结果可复现，科研智能体将从提出假设进一步进入实验数据解读，并把昂贵、耗时的晶体分析环节转化为可规模化训练任务。

breaking_news.headline_zh: OpenAI 发布模型失配披露框架并公开六份案例报告
breaking_news.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布跟踪、调查和公开模型失配实例的框架，规定披露条件与时间线，即使行为尚未完全解释或缓解也可公开；同时发布近六个月训练和评估中观察到的六份失配案例报告。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 这是把模型安全中的异常行为从零散披露转向持续、带时限的制度化报告；它可能为其他前沿实验室和外部审计建立新的透明度基线。

breaking_news.headline_zh: 预印本报告 AI 设计的 MsbA 抗生素候选物在小鼠感染模型中降低菌负荷
breaking_news.summary_zh: 一篇 bioRxiv 预印本报告，以 Link-INVENT 和 AutoMolDesigner 设计出靶向 MsbA 的小分子 Y-11；其在耐碳青霉烯鲍曼不动杆菌模型中显示活性，并在小鼠感染实验中降低菌负荷。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: MsbA 是革兰阴性菌外膜生物合成的关键靶点。若后续药代、安全性和临床前结果成立，这为用生成式设计开辟抗耐药菌新机制候选物提供了实证路线。

items.title: Deep reinforcement learning-driven discovery of a MsbA-targeted small-molecule antibiotic for the treatment of Acinetobacter baumannii infection
items.abstract_or_text: Antibiotics with new mechanisms are highly pursued to address the threat of infections caused by drug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria. Targeting MsbA, a key protein of the lipopolysaccharide biosynthesis pathway, represents a promising strategy to discover new classes of antibiotics. However, currently available MsbA-targeted molecules either lack sufficient potency or have unfavorable properties, necessitating expansion of chemical space. In this study, we chose the most promising cerastecin Cpd 4 as the template, and used two Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based tools, i.e. Link-INVENT and AutoMolDesigner for molecular design, performed chemical derivatization and antibacterial activity evaluation, which led to the discovery of Y-11 (MIC for A. baumannii: 0.5 g/mL). Encouragingly, Y-11 showed equivalent potency to Cpd4 for carbapenem-resistant A. baumannii, and less cytotoxicity and hemolysis as well as lower spontaneous resistance frequency. In vivo efficacy study demonstrated that Y-11 could effectively reduce bacterial loads in the mice infected by A. baumannii. The following mechanism study including molecular dynamics simulation, biochemical assay, and transmission electron microscope (TEM) analysis suggested that Y-11 inhibited the transport of lipooligosaccharide and impaired the formation of outer membrane, probably by competitively binding to the substrate binding site of MsbA and modulating ATPase activity. Taken together, we have discovered a MsbA-targeted small molecule Y-11 via AI-driven drug design, which provides a foundation for future antibiotic development.
items.summary_zh: 以 cerastecin Cpd 4 为起点，研究结合 Link-INVENT 与 AutoMolDesigner 进行分子设计、化学衍生化和抗菌评估，获得靶向 MsbA 的小分子 Y-11；摘要报告其在耐碳青霉烯鲍曼不动杆菌、细胞毒性/溶血、耐药频率、小鼠感染模型及多种机制实验中的结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将生成式设计接入抗革兰阴性菌先导物优化，并给出体内、药化性质和机制层面的连贯证据。需注意这是预印本，且摘要中的 MIC 单位为 0.5 g/mL，应以原始实验数据和后续复现为准。
items.abstract_zh: 具有新机制的抗生素对于应对耐药革兰阴性菌感染的威胁备受追求。靶向脂多糖生物合成途径中的关键蛋白 MsbA，是发现新型抗生素的一项有前景策略。然而，现有的 MsbA 靶向分子要么效力不足，要么性质不理想，因此有必要拓展化学空间。在本研究中，我们选择最有前景的 cerastecin Cpd 4 作为模板，使用两种基于人工智能（AI）的分子设计工具，即 Link-INVENT 和 AutoMolDesigner，开展化学衍生化及抗菌活性评价，进而发现了 Y-11（对 A. baumannii 的 MIC：0.5 g/mL）。令人鼓舞的是，Y-11 对耐碳青霉烯 A. baumannii 的效力与 Cpd4 相当，且细胞毒性和溶血更低、自发耐药频率更低。体内疗效研究表明，Y-11 可有效降低 A. baumannii 感染小鼠体内的细菌载量。后续机制研究，包括分子动力学模拟、生化测定和透射电子显微镜（TEM）分析，提示 Y-11 通过竞争性结合 MsbA 的底物结合位点并调节 ATPase 活性，抑制脂寡糖转运并破坏外膜形成。总之，我们通过 AI 驱动的药物设计发现了靶向 MsbA 的小分子 Y-11，为未来抗生素开发奠定了基础。

items.title: ABCP_finder: A Transformer Embedding-Based Prediction of Anti-Breast Cancer Peptides
items.abstract_or_text: Breast cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths among women worldwide. Drug resistance, toxicity, and limited target specificity are the major challenges in the development of effective therapeutics. Anti-breast cancer peptides (ABCPs) have emerged as effective drug candidate due to its low toxicity, high selectivity, and ability to target cancer. However, it is very time consuming and expensive to identify novel ABCPs only through experiment methods. To address this challenge, we developed ABCP_finder, the first dedicated computational framework specifically designed for the prediction of ABCPs using transformer-based protein language model embeddings. Positive and negative datasets were carefully constructed to ensure a biologically meaningful classification task. To prevent the data leakage and realistic evaluation, homology aware train-test split strategy was utilized by using CD-HIT at 30% sequence identity with 80% coverage. Peptide representations were generated using pretrained transformer models, ProtBERT and ESM2, followed by classification using a multilayer perceptron (MLP). Among the tested models, ProtBERT showed superior performance, achieving 93.82% accuracy, 86.88% recall, 90.59% F1-score, 0.8618 MCC, 96.67% AUC, and a Brier Score of 0.0633, demonstrating strong predictive capability under imbalanced conditions. Calibration analysis supported the selection of a 0.7 probability threshold for identifying high confidence ABCPs. Further external validation using xDeep-AcPEP demonstrated that unknown peptide sequences that has been predicted as ABCPs by ABCP_finder are exhibiting favourable IC values. This supports the biological relevance of these unknown peptides. Overall, ABCP_finder provides a reliable and practical platform for large-scale ABCP screening and can significantly accelerate the discovery of novel peptide therapeutics for breast cancer treatment.
items.summary_zh: ABCP_finder 将 ProtBERT 或 ESM2 的蛋白语言模型嵌入与 MLP 分类器结合，通过 CD-HIT 的同源性识别划分预测抗乳腺癌肽；摘要报告 ProtBERT 模型在不平衡数据上的性能、校准阈值及 xDeep-AcPEP 外部验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其同源性控制的训练—测试划分和概率校准有助于降低肽预测中常见的数据泄漏与过度自信风险。限制在于外部验证主要是计算性支持，尚未报告候选肽的直接实验抗肿瘤验证。
items.abstract_zh: 乳腺癌仍是全球女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。耐药性、毒性和靶点特异性有限是开发有效疗法面临的主要挑战。抗乳腺癌肽（ABCPs）因其低毒性、高选择性和靶向癌症的能力，已成为有效的药物候选物。然而，仅通过实验方法鉴定新的 ABCPs 十分耗时且昂贵。为应对这一挑战，我们开发了 ABCP_finder，这是首个专门利用基于 Transformer 的蛋白语言模型嵌入预测 ABCPs 的计算框架。经过审慎构建正、负数据集，以确保分类任务具有生物学意义。为防止数据泄漏并实现现实的评估，我们使用 CD-HIT，在 30% 序列一致性和 80% 覆盖度下采用同源性识别的训练—测试划分策略。肽表征由预训练 Transformer 模型 ProtBERT 和 ESM2 生成，随后使用多层感知器（MLP）进行分类。在所测试模型中，ProtBERT 显示出更优性能，取得 93.82% 准确率、86.88% 召回率、90.59% F1 分数、0.8618 MCC、96.67% AUC 和 0.0633 的 Brier 分数，表明其在不平衡条件下具有较强预测能力。校准分析支持采用 0.7 概率阈值来鉴定高置信度 ABCPs。利用 xDeep-AcPEP 进行的进一步外部验证表明，被 ABCP_finder 预测为 ABCPs 的未知肽序列表现出有利的 IC 值。这支持了这些未知肽的生物学相关性。总体而言，ABCP_finder 为大规模 ABCP 筛选提供了可靠、实用的平台，并可显著加速用于乳腺癌治疗的新型肽类疗法发现。

items.title: Comprehensive Chemical Space Exploration in De Novo Drug Design: An Algorithmically Constrained, Parallel Dual-Paradigm Framework Validated on BACE1
items.abstract_or_text: Isolated de novo drug design paradigms carry inherent vulnerabilities: ligand-based (LBDD) models risk unreliable extrapolation beyond their training domain, while structure-based (SBDD) genetic algorithms accumulate molecular size-bias across evolutionary generations. Furthermore, on structurally complex targets, deploying either paradigm in isolation risks systematically excluding viable chemical space. Here, we introduce a dual-paradigm framework addressing both failure modes through two novel algorithmic constraints: a Zoned Applicability Domain (AD) integrated as a live reinforcement learning reward gradient, and the Size-Independent Ligand Efficiency (SILE) metric deployed as a generational fitness function. A convergent validation cascade - pharmacokinetic filtering, exhaustive docking, and molecular dynamics - is architecturally positioned to eliminate artifacts these constrained engines may still produce. We evaluated this workflow on β-secretase (BACE1), deliberately selected because its electrostatic catalytic dyad and hydrophobic sub-pockets present divergent reward landscapes. Ablation studies confirmed the Zoned AD suppressed out-of-domain artifacts to enrich extrapolation, while SILE prevented meaningless molecular bloat compared to baseline models. The LBDD pipeline autonomously rediscovered 10 withheld experimental inhibitors, while the SBDD pipeline successfully decoupled docking affinity from molecular size, with both yielding leads with thermodynamic profiles comparable to the clinical reference verubecestat. Critically, the campaign demonstrated a fundamental algorithmic divergence: LBDD generates data-driven compounds inheriting the binding topology of known inhibitors, while SBDD explores pocket-complementary space with substantially different binding mechanisms. This suggests that parallel deployment of constrained paradigms may be necessary for systematic coverage of a target's viable binding space.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出并行的配体基础与结构基础从头设计框架，以 Zoned Applicability Domain 作为实时强化学习奖励梯度、以 SILE 作为代际适应度函数，并在 BACE1 上结合药代过滤、穷尽对接和分子动力学进行评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接针对域外外推和遗传算法分子尺寸膨胀两类常见失效模式，并以消融和留出抑制剂重发现提供验证。其证据仍主要来自计算级联和已知抑制剂重发现，不能等同于新先导物的实验药效或临床可行性。
items.abstract_zh: 孤立的从头药物设计范式带有固有脆弱性：基于配体的药物设计（LBDD）模型在其训练域之外有不可靠外推的风险，而基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）遗传算法会在进化世代中累积分子尺寸偏倚。此外，在结构复杂的靶点上，单独采用任一范式都有系统性排除可行化学空间的风险。本文引入一个双范式框架，通过两项新的算法约束应对这两类失效模式：将 Zoned Applicability Domain（AD）整合为实时强化学习奖励梯度，以及将 Size-Independent Ligand Efficiency（SILE）指标部署为代际适应度函数。一个由药代动力学过滤、穷尽对接和分子动力学构成的收敛验证级联，在架构上用于消除这些受约束引擎仍可能产生的伪影。我们在 β-分泌酶（BACE1）上评估该工作流，特意选择该靶点是因为其静电催化二联体和疏水亚口袋呈现不同的奖励景观。消融研究证实，Zoned AD 抑制了域外伪影以富集外推结果，而 SILE 相较基线模型防止了无意义的分子膨胀。LBDD 管线自主重新发现了 10 个留出的实验抑制剂，SBDD 管线则成功将对接亲和力与分子尺寸解耦；二者均产生了热力学特征与临床参照物 verubecestat 相当的先导物。关键的是，该项目展示出根本性的算法分歧：LBDD 生成继承已知抑制剂结合拓扑的数据驱动化合物，而 SBDD 探索具有显著不同结合机制的口袋互补空间。这表明，受约束范式的并行部署可能是系统覆盖一个靶点可行结合空间所必需的。

items.title: HARIBOSS++: An Integrated Platform for RNA-Targeted Drug Design
items.abstract_or_text: Targeting RNA with small molecules is increasingly viewed as a pivotal strategy for future therapeutics. A major limitation in studying RNA-small molecule (RNA-SM) interactions is the lack of available experimental structures. HARIBOSS established a milestone as a curated database of RNA-SM complexes derived from the Protein Data Bank. Building on its community engagement, we present HARIBOSS++, an updated and next-generation platform designed to facilitate the study of future RNA-targeted drugs. Major updates include an extension of the pocketome to encompass binding sites where small molecules interact not only with RNA but also with other biomolecules, enhanced analysis of RNA molecules by family, detailed 3D structural characterization, improved analysis of ligands chemical space, addition of experimental binding affinity as well as molecular dynamics data, when available. HARIBOSS++ opens new avenues for biologists, bioinformaticians, and machine learning researchers to investigate RNA-SM interactions on a new scale. HARIBOSS++ can be explored using a web interface freely available at https://hariboss.pasteur.cloud.
items.summary_zh: HARIBOSS++ 扩展了源自 Protein Data Bank 的 RNA—小分子复合物数据库：新增含其他生物分子的结合位点、RNA 家族与三维结构分析、配体化学空间分析，以及可获得时的实验亲和力和分子动力学数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它为 RNA 靶向小分子研究和机器学习提供了更结构化的数据基础，可缓解实验复合物结构稀缺的问题。限制是该工作主要为资源升级；摘要未提供模型基准或新候选物的实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 利用小分子靶向 RNA 日益被视为未来治疗学的关键策略。研究 RNA—小分子（RNA-SM）相互作用的一个主要限制，是缺乏可用的实验结构。HARIBOSS 作为源自 Protein Data Bank 的 RNA-SM 复合物精选数据库，已建立了一个里程碑。在其社区参与的基础上，我们提出 HARIBOSS++，这是一个经更新的下一代平台，旨在促进未来 RNA 靶向药物的研究。主要更新包括：将 pocketome 扩展至小分子不仅与 RNA、也与其他生物分子相互作用的结合位点；增强按家族对 RNA 分子的分析；详细的三维结构表征；改进的配体化学空间分析；以及在可获得时加入实验结合亲和力和分子动力学数据。HARIBOSS++ 为生物学家、生物信息学家和机器学习研究者以新的尺度研究 RNA-SM 相互作用开辟了新途径。HARIBOSS++ 可通过一个免费开放的网页界面浏览，网址为 https://hariboss.pasteur.cloud。
items.author_line: Marengo, M., Chapeaublanc, E., Menager, H., Gkeka, P., Bonomi, M.

items.title: SimSJSAlert: A Similarity-Augmented Multi-View Learning Framework with Scaffold Alerts for Drug-Induced Stevens-Johnson Syndrome Risk Assessment
items.abstract_or_text: Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS) is a rare, life-threatening adverse drug reaction for which early identification of high-risk drugs remains challenging. In this study, we developed an explainable quantitative structure-toxicity relationship (QSTR) framework for SJS prediction using a multi-view learning framework with 21 molecular representations, including molecular descriptors, fingerprints, transformer-based embeddings, and a molecular similarity representation. Model development and evaluation were designed in accordance with the OECD principles for QSAR validation, incorporating scaffold-aware validation, external evaluation on pharmacovigilance negative-signal compounds, and structural interpretation by integrating SHAP with Bemis-Murcko scaffold enrichment analysis. The proposed framework achieved robust sensitivity and specificity, with molecular similarity consistently improving the identification of SJS-associated compounds. Furthermore, a consensus prediction and scaffold-based prioritization strategy identified several high-risk drugs from the 1 external negative-signal dataset, including cefprozil, tetracycline, and omadacycline, highlighting their potential association with SJS and warranting further pharmacovigilance and experimental investigation. To facilitate practical application, this was deployed as a freely accessible web server, SimSJSAlert (https: //sim-sjs-alert.streamlit.app/), enabling rapid drug-induced SJS risk assessment. The proposed framework combines predictive performance, interpretability, and accessibility to support early SJS risk assessment, pharmacovigilance signal prioritization, and safer drug development.
items.summary_zh: SimSJSAlert 使用 21 种分子表征、相似性增强的多视图学习和骨架警示，构建可解释的 Stevens-Johnson syndrome 药物风险 QSTR 框架；评估包含骨架感知验证、外部药物警戒负信号集和 SHAP—Bemis-Murcko 骨架解析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 框架同时强调 QSAR 验证原则、结构可解释性和可访问的网页部署，可用于药物警戒信号优先级排序。摘要中发现的高风险药物只是待验证信号，不能据此推定 SJS 因果关系或直接改变临床用药。
items.abstract_zh: Stevens-Johnson syndrome（SJS）是一种罕见、危及生命的药物不良反应，早期识别高风险药物仍具挑战。本研究开发了一个用于 SJS 预测的可解释定量结构—毒性关系（QSTR）框架；该框架采用多视图学习，使用 21 种分子表征，包括分子描述符、指纹、基于 Transformer 的嵌入和分子相似性表征。模型开发和评估遵循 OECD 的 QSAR 验证原则，纳入骨架感知验证、对药物警戒负信号化合物的外部评估，以及通过整合 SHAP 与 Bemis-Murcko 骨架富集分析进行的结构解释。所提出的框架取得了稳健的敏感性和特异性，分子相似性持续改善了对 SJS 相关化合物的识别。此外，一项共识预测和基于骨架的优先级排序策略，从 1 个外部负信号数据集中识别出若干高风险药物，包括 cefprozil、tetracycline 和 omadacycline，凸显其与 SJS 的潜在关联，值得进一步药物警戒和实验研究。为便于实际应用，该方法被部署为可免费访问的网页服务器 SimSJSAlert（https: //sim-sjs-alert.streamlit.app/），可实现快速的药物诱发 SJS 风险评估。所提出的框架结合了预测性能、可解释性和可访问性，以支持早期 SJS 风险评估、药物警戒信号优先级排序和更安全的药物开发。
items.author_line: Huynh Anh Duy, Sastiya Kampaengsri, Supreeya Paiboon, Tarapong Srisongkram

items.title: Machine Learning-Guided Classification of Druggable Pockets and Phylogenetic Druggability Transfer Across the Human Kinome
items.abstract_or_text: Protein kinases are among the most intensively pursued therapeutic targets in oncology and beyond, yet selectivity remains largely unsolved; around 536 Manning kinase domains share a conserved ATP-binding pocket, making it difficult to target one without hitting others. Allosteric binding modes which exploit conformational states unique to individual kinases or narrow kinase subfamilies offer a principled route to selectivity. Yet the absence of a kinome-wide structural landscape of these pockets limits their translational potential. Here we construct a machine learning-guided structural atlas of 11,945 kinase inhibitor complexes, training an Extra Trees classifier on pocket residue interaction with ligand to assign all seven canonical binding modes and resolve allosteric subclasses with pharmacological precision. Our structural analysis reveals that approximately 303 Manning kinase domains have known inhibitors bound to them, representing ~56.5% of the Manning kinase domain; of these, only 26% (78 kinases) are targeted by non-ATP-competitive allosteric inhibitors, indicating substantial unexplored pharmacological space. Integrating these classifications with the Manning kinome phylogeny, we demonstrate that evolutionary proximity is a statistically significant predictor of shared allosteric pocket accessibility. Because a functionally similar target has similar conformational dynamics and similar druggable pockets, 'phylogenetic druggability transfer' can act as a strong signal for identifying whether a given kinase can be targeted using an allosteric inhibitor or not. In addition, this work repositions the kinome phylogeny as a map of pharmacological opportunity and provides a reusable predictive framework for drug discovery programs - including orthosteric, allosteric, covalent, bifunctional inhibitors, and chemical degrader - across the understudied kinome.
items.summary_zh: 研究从 11,945 个激酶抑制剂复合物构建机器学习引导的结构图谱，用 Extra Trees 按配体—口袋残基相互作用分类七种规范结合模式，并将别构口袋可及性与人类激酶组系统发育相结合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该图谱将选择性激酶药物发现中的别构机会转化为可检验的结构与进化学假设。摘要报告的是分类和统计关联，系统发育“可成药性转移”对具体未研究激酶的预测仍需要实验检验。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白激酶是肿瘤学及其他领域中最受密集追求的治疗靶点之一，但选择性在很大程度上仍未解决；约 536 个 Manning 激酶结构域共享一个保守的 ATP 结合口袋，使得靶向其中一个而不命中其他激酶变得困难。利用个别激酶或狭窄激酶亚家族特有构象状态的别构结合模式，为选择性提供了一条有原则的路径。然而，缺乏覆盖整个激酶组的这些口袋的结构景观，限制了其转化潜力。本文构建了一个由机器学习引导的 11,945 个激酶抑制剂复合物结构图谱，在配体与口袋残基相互作用上训练 Extra Trees 分类器，以分配全部七种规范结合模式，并以药理学精度解析别构亚类。我们的结构分析表明，约 303 个 Manning 激酶结构域已有结合其上的已知抑制剂，约占 Manning 激酶结构域的 56.5%；其中只有 26%（78 个激酶）被非 ATP 竞争性别构抑制剂靶向，表明存在大量未探索的药理学空间。将这些分类与 Manning 激酶组系统发育相整合后，我们证明进化接近性是共享别构口袋可及性的统计学显著预测因子。由于功能相似的靶点具有相似的构象动力学和相似的可成药口袋，“系统发育可成药性转移”可以作为识别特定激酶能否被别构抑制剂靶向的强信号。此外，这项工作将激酶组系统发育重新定位为药理机会图谱，并为跨未充分研究激酶组的药物发现项目提供可复用的预测框架——包括正构、别构、共价、双功能抑制剂和化学降解剂。
items.author_line: Chauhan, R., Rajiah, A. D., Natarajan, A. M.

items.title: Ourotide: decoding the hierarchical peptide recognition for generative design
items.abstract_or_text: The historical dichotomy between small-molecule pocket and extended protein interfaces misrepresents the physical reality of peptide recognition.1,2 Here we show that peptide binding is not a simple structural intermediate but a distinctly multimodal landscape comprising small-molecule-like pockets, protein-like interfaces, and a previously unrecognized third mode. This third regime is governed by a hierarchical subpocket architecture where a flattened surface achieves near-complete peptide engagement through spatially partitioned hydrophobic components. To maintain stability, an incompletely enclosed dominant anchor cooperates with highly hydrated auxiliary subpockets and an asymmetric receptor coupling mechanism that concentrates energy in an adjacent continuous water network. Because this unique binding mode suffers from extreme data scarcity, standard deep learning models fail to capture its physics.3,4 To resolve this, we mapped these specific geometric signatures to mine structurally faithful training distributions from global protein interactomes. Based on these data, we trained Ourotide, a deep learning framework coupling conditional geometric flow matching with interface-aware affinity learning. Evaluated across peptides up to 65 residues, Ourotide outperforms generalist models in backbone accuracy, interface recovery, and affinity prediction. This approach suggests that overcoming data scarcity in the physical sciences requires physics-guided data augmentation rather than naive statistical scaling.
items.summary_zh: Ourotide 先刻画肽识别中由分层亚口袋和水网络主导的第三种结合模式，再从全局蛋白相互作用组挖掘结构可信的训练分布，并以条件几何流匹配和界面感知亲和力学习生成肽设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作以物理机制引导数据增广，直面肽—蛋白界面数据稀缺问题，并报告在最长 65 残基肽上的结构和亲和力基准优势。摘要未给出湿实验或功能验证，生成结果的可合成性和生物活性仍待确认。
items.abstract_zh: 将小分子口袋与延展蛋白界面对立起来的历史二分法，误表征了肽识别的物理现实。¹,² 我们在此表明，肽结合并非简单的结构中间态，而是一种截然不同的多模态景观，包含类小分子口袋、类蛋白界面，以及此前未被认识到的第三种模式。第三种状态由分层亚口袋架构支配：一个扁平表面通过空间分隔的疏水组分实现近乎完全的肽结合。为维持稳定性，一个未完全封闭的主导锚点与高度水合的辅助亚口袋及非对称受体耦合机制协同，后者将能量集中于相邻的连续水网络中。由于这种独特结合模式遭受极端数据稀缺，标准深度学习模型无法捕捉其物理学。³,⁴ 为解决这一问题，我们将这些特异几何特征映射出来，从全局蛋白相互作用组中挖掘结构忠实的训练分布。基于这些数据，我们训练了 Ourotide，一个将条件几何流匹配与界面感知亲和力学习耦合的深度学习框架。在最长 65 个残基的肽上评估时，Ourotide 在主链准确度、界面恢复和亲和力预测方面优于通用模型。这一方法表明，克服物理科学中的数据稀缺需要物理引导的数据增广，而不是朴素的统计规模扩张。

items.title: Towards an Accurate Atomistic Description of Procaine Crystals: Force Field Development and MD Simulation of Solid-to-Liquid Phase Transitions
items.abstract_or_text: Rational design of crystalline materials is crucial for material science and pharmaceutical development, requiring molecular modeling as a powerful complementary tool. This study employs molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the thermal stability, structural evolution, and melting mechanisms of crystalline procaine base across a temperature range of 23 to 373 K. To evaluate potential finite-size and boundary effects, two distinct computational setups were considered: a bulk crystal model under periodic boundary conditions (System I, 600 molecules) and an isolated nanocrystal in vacuum (System II, 1188 molecules). Both systems demonstrate well-preserved long-range positional ordering from 23 to 313 K, followed by the appearance of a plastic crystalline state with enhanced rotational freedom between 323 and 333 K. At 343 K, a heterogeneous, surface-initiated phase transition to an isotropic melt occurs, which closely matches the experimental melting point of procaine free-base of 334-337 K. MD analysis reveals remarkably slow melting kinetics at 333-343 K, where a crystalline core persists for over 300 ns before complete melting at 500 ns. We found that the thermal breakdown of the crystal lattice strongly correlates with a breakage of the intermolecular hydrogen-bonding 3D network between procaine molecules. Radial distribution function (RDF) analysis shows a sharp shift in the primary amino nitrogen correlations (N10···N10) towards short-distances upon melting, whereas short-range hydrogen-bond N10···O9 distances remain spatially invariant in the liquid phase. Mean square displacement (MSD) of procaine molecules demonstrates a dramatic transition from restricted lattice vibrations below 333 K to active fluid diffusion above 343 K. These findings are accompanied by rotational autocorrelation functions transition from long-time orientational persistence in the solid state (23-333 K) to rapid exponential relaxation in the melt (343-373 K). Finally, unconstrained melting of System II produces a spherical nanodroplet driven by surface tension minimization, confirming that the performance of the developed OPLS-AA FF model.
items.summary_zh: 研究开发 OPLS-AA 力场，以 MD 模拟比较周期性体相晶体与真空纳米晶中 procaine base 在 23–373 K 的结构演化、塑晶态和熔融过程，并与实验熔点对照。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把晶型热稳定性、氢键网络和熔融动力学连接到原子尺度模型，对药物晶体和材料设计有参考价值。力场的适用范围及熔融动力学主要来自模拟，仍需更多独立实验和跨体系验证。
items.abstract_zh: 晶体材料的理性设计对材料科学和药物开发至关重要，并需要分子建模作为有力的互补工具。本研究采用分子动力学（MD）模拟，考察结晶 procaine base 在 23 至 373 K 温度范围内的热稳定性、结构演化和熔融机制。为评估潜在的有限尺寸和边界效应，考虑了两种不同计算设置：周期性边界条件下的体相晶体模型（System I，600 个分子）以及真空中的孤立纳米晶（System II，1188 个分子）。两个体系均在 23 至 313 K 保持良好的长程位置有序，随后在 323 至 333 K 之间出现转动自由度增强的塑晶态。在 343 K 时，发生了由表面引发的异质性相变，形成各向同性熔体，这与 procaine free-base 的实验熔点 334–337 K 高度吻合。MD 分析揭示了在 333–343 K 极慢的熔融动力学：晶体核心在 500 ns 才完全熔融前持续超过 300 ns。我们发现，晶格的热崩解与 procaine 分子间氢键三维网络的断裂强烈相关。径向分布函数（RDF）分析显示，熔融时主氨基氮相关性（N10···N10）向短距离急剧移动，而短程氢键 N10···O9 距离在液相中保持空间不变。procaine 分子的均方位移（MSD）表明，体系从 333 K 以下受限的晶格振动，剧烈转变为 343 K 以上活跃的流体扩散。这些发现伴随着转动自相关函数从固态（23–333 K）的长时间取向保持，转变为熔体（343–373 K）中的快速指数弛豫。最后，System II 的无约束熔融产生一个由表面张力最小化驱动的球形纳米液滴，证实了所开发 OPLS-AA FF 模型的表现。
items.author_line: Viktoriia O. Chukhlib, Viktor V. Tokariev, Alexander Kyrychenko

items.title: Force-Programmed Evolution of Topological Freedom in Slide-Ring Polymer Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Force-adaptive polymer networks, whose mechanical response evolves under load, offer a route to structural materials that combine high stiffness and strength with efficient energy dissipation.[1,2] Most existing force-adaptive systems achieve this through mechanochemical reactions that generate reactive intermediates and thereby stiffen or rearrange the network,[3-5] a strategy that is intrinsically limited by diffusion, reaction kinetics, and the irreversible consumption of the reactive species. Here we pursue a fundamentally different strategy, in which a force-triggered transformation regulates the topological freedom of a slide-ring crosslink[6,7] rather than driving a chemical reaction. We integrate a mechanophore directly into the stopper of a rotaxane crosslinker, in which a cyclobutane formed by the [2+2] photodimerization of two cinnamate units[8,9] acts as the bulky stopper that confines a 24-crown-8 macrocycle on a dibenzylammonium axle.[10,11] Under load, retro-[2+2] cycloreversion reduces the steric dimension of the stopper and thereby expands the sliding space accessible to the macrocycle, so that a single covalent event gates a large slidingdissipation channel rather than dissipating energy directly. We incorporated this crosslinker into a segmented polyurethane and evaluated it against an orthogonal three-member sample set (R, C1, C2) of identical crosslinker content that decouples whether the stopper can open from whether the macrocycle can slide. The optimal composition, R3, reaches a toughness of about 215 MJ m-3 and a tensile strength of about 38 MPa—up to 9.4 and 5.6 times the toughness and strength of the openbut-cannot-slide control (C1), and far exceeding the constitutively sliding control (C2). Smallstrain dynamic mechanical analysis confirms that the mechanophore is silent at low strain, whereas gradient cyclic loading reveals a force-activation fingerprint: the dissipation ratio of R3 rises from below both controls at 100% strain to above them at high strain, crossing over near 300–400%. Infrared spectroscopy detects the regenerated cinnamate C=C band only after stretching and only in the cyclobutane-bearing samples,[8,9] and an annealing-reload test shows that the extra dissipation of R3 is largely recoverable with the smallest permanent damage of the three, consistent with a reversible sliding channel that shields the matrix.[12,13] These results establish a general design principle in which the structural precision of a mechanochemical transformation programs the evolution of topological freedom during deformation.
items.summary_zh: 研究将可受力逆 [2+2] 环裂解的 cinnamate—cyclobutane mechanophore 装入 rotaxane slide-ring 交联剂，使受力改变环的拓扑滑移自由度；在分段聚氨酯中以正交对照、力学、红外和循环加载实验验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提出以单个共价事件开启大尺度可逆滑移耗散通道的材料设计原则，并报告了显著韧性和强度提升。性能目前限于特定聚氨酯配方和加载条件，长期循环稳定性及可制造性尚未由摘要确立。
items.abstract_zh: 受力自适应聚合物网络的力学响应会在载荷下演化，为兼具高刚度和强度以及高效能量耗散的结构材料提供了一条路径。¹,² 大多数现有受力自适应体系通过生成反应性中间体并由此使网络硬化或重排的机械化学反应实现这一点，³–⁵ 但该策略本质上受扩散、反应动力学和反应物不可逆消耗的限制。本文采用一种根本不同的策略：受力触发的转化调控 slide-ring crosslink 的拓扑自由度，⁶,⁷ 而非驱动化学反应。我们将 mechanophore 直接整合到 rotaxane crosslinker 的 stopper 中：两个 cinnamate 单元 [2+2] 光二聚形成的 cyclobutane，⁸,⁹ 充当 bulky stopper，将 24-crown-8 macrocycle 限制在 dibenzylammonium axle 上。受载时，retro-[2+2] cycloreversion 降低 stopper 的位阻尺寸，进而扩展 macrocycle 可进入的滑移空间，使单个共价事件开启一个大的滑移耗散通道，而不是直接耗散能量。我们将该交联剂纳入分段聚氨酯中，并以交联剂含量相同的正交三成员样本组（R、C1、C2）进行评价，该样本组将 stopper 能否打开与 macrocycle 能否滑移解耦。最优组成 R3 的韧性约为 215 MJ m-3、拉伸强度约为 38 MPa，分别达到只能打开但不能滑移的对照（C1）韧性和强度的最高 9.4 倍和 5.6 倍，并远超始终可滑移的对照（C2）。小应变动态力学分析证实 mechanophore 在低应变下处于静默状态；而梯度循环加载揭示了受力活化指纹：R3 的耗散比在 100% 应变时低于两个对照，在高应变时高于它们，交叉点约在 300–400%。红外光谱仅在拉伸后且仅在含 cyclobutane 的样品中检测到再生的 cinnamate C=C 吸收带，⁸,⁹ 退火—再加载试验显示，R3 的额外耗散在三种样品中以最小的永久损伤大部分可恢复，这与保护基体的可逆滑移通道一致。¹²,¹³ 这些结果确立了一项通用设计原则：机械化学转化的结构精确性可编程化变形过程中拓扑自由度的演化。
items.author_line: Chenjuan Yu, Yuping Wang

items.title: Calibrated structural homology transfer yields putative molecular functions for domains of unknown function in four model proteomes
items.abstract_or_text: Improvements in computational protein structure prediction have enabled searches for remote homologs of proteins whose molecular function remain unknown. However, the reliability of functional annotations from such searches has not been systematically quantified. In this study, we assembled a time-split benchmark from Pfam families annotated as domains of unknown function (DUFs) in Pfam 28.0 and were subsequently assigned a function in the current release (Pfam 38.0). These retrospective-DUFs provide ground truth for assessing functional annotation from remote homology searches. In our benchmark analysis, we paired retrospective-DUFs with a difficulty-matched arm from known domains to distinguish query difficulty from the method's performance. Across four model proteomes (yeast, C. elegans, Drosophila, and mice), Foldseek searches against AlphaFold/Swiss-Prot, PDB100, and CATH50 recovered the later-assigned function for 15.9% of retrospective DUF queries, compared with 30.1% of matched known-domain queries, after masking for self-family and self-clan level hits to remove circularity. At a fixed confidence cut-off (qTM [≥] 0.5), 55.4% of informative calls on retrospective DUFs were incorrect, establishing an error model for prospective use. Furthermore, in our comparison of tools for homology searches, Foldseek outperformed MMseq2-based sequence search but was not statistically separable from the ESM-2 protein language model embedding baseline. Applying the calibrated structural homology search pipeline to 296 currently unannotated DUF queries in Pfam 38.0 yielded 50 confident, specific functional assignments. We provide the benchmark and ranked candidates as a resource to facilitate functional studies.
items.summary_zh: 研究以曾在 Pfam 28.0 中标为 DUF、后在 Pfam 38.0 获得功能的家族构建时间切分基准，校准 Foldseek 的远程结构同源功能转移错误率，并将其应用到四种模式蛋白质组中当前未注释 DUF。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作量化了结构预测时代“由同源性推功能”的可靠性，并公开了候选资源；其 55.4% 的错误率也明确提示不能把结构相似直接当作功能注释。50 个前瞻性指派仍是待实验验证的假设。
items.abstract_zh: 计算蛋白结构预测的进展使得搜索分子功能未知蛋白的远程同源物成为可能。然而，此类搜索所得功能注释的可靠性尚未被系统量化。在本研究中，我们从在 Pfam 28.0 中被注释为功能未知结构域（DUFs）、并在当前版本 Pfam 38.0 中随后获赋功能的 Pfam 家族中构建了一个时间切分基准。这些回顾性 DUFs 为评估远程同源搜索所得功能注释提供了真实标签。在基准分析中，我们将回顾性 DUFs 与来自已知结构域、且难度匹配的一组配对，以区分查询难度和方法性能。在四种模式生物蛋白质组（酵母、C. elegans、Drosophila 和小鼠）中，针对 AlphaFold/Swiss-Prot、PDB100 和 CATH50 的 Foldseek 搜索，在屏蔽自身家族和自身 clan 水平命中以消除循环性后，为 15.9% 的回顾性 DUF 查询找回了后来赋予的功能；而难度匹配的已知结构域查询为 30.1%。在固定置信度阈值（qTM ≥ 0.5）下，回顾性 DUF 中 55.4% 的信息性调用是错误的，为前瞻性使用建立了误差模型。此外，在我们对同源搜索工具的比较中，Foldseek 优于基于 MMseq2 的序列搜索，但与 ESM-2 蛋白语言模型嵌入基线在统计上不可区分。将校准后的结构同源搜索管线应用于 Pfam 38.0 中 296 个当前未注释的 DUF 查询，得到 50 个高置信度、特异性的功能指派。我们提供该基准和排序后的候选物作为促进功能研究的资源。
items.author_line: Vedanayagam, J.

items.title: High-Entropy Catalysts for Lithium-Sulfur and Room-Temperature Sodium-Sulfur Batteries: Electronic Descriptors, Performance, and Design Challenges
items.abstract_or_text: Lithium-sulfur (Li-S) and room-temperature sodium-sulfur (RT Na-S) batteries offer high theoretical energy density at low materials cost, but the insulating nature of sulfur, the shuttling of soluble polysulfides, and sluggish multistep redox kinetics limit their practical use. Catalysts that anchor polysulfides and accelerate their conversion are a widely investigated remedy, and the field is moving from single-metal catalysts toward high-entropy catalysts (HECs) built from five or more principal elements. This review is organized around the electronic descriptors, principally the d-band center and its refinements, that are used to connect multi-element composition to polysulfide adsorption and to reaction barriers. We define configurational entropy quantitatively, separate genuine HECs from lower-order multimetal catalysts, survey the alloy, oxide, sulfide, and single-atom families with attention to mechanism and limitations, and treat the still under-demonstrated RT Na-S case explicitly. We then examine the first-principles workflow required for chemically disordered surfaces and the emerging, mostly non-sulfur, use of machine learning (ML). Our central conclusion is that the d-band center is a useful but non-universal descriptor whose predictive value depends on local coordination, oxidation state, surface reconstruction, solvation, and polysulfide coverage, and that direct evidence for entropy-derived synergy, and for high-entropy catalysis in RT Na-S specifically, remains incomplete.
items.summary_zh: 该综述围绕 d-band center 等电子描述符，梳理由五种及以上主要元素构成的高熵催化剂在 Li-S 与室温 Na-S 电池中对多硫化物吸附和转化的作用，并讨论无序表面的一性原理与机器学习工作流。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 综述清晰区分高熵与低阶多金属催化剂，并指出描述符、熵协同及室温 Na-S 证据的边界，可避免过度解读性能报告。它是综述性工作，且摘要明确指出关键机制和 RT Na-S 直接证据尚不完整。
items.abstract_zh: 锂硫（Li-S）和室温钠硫（RT Na-S）电池具有高理论能量密度和低材料成本，但硫的绝缘性、可溶多硫化物的穿梭以及缓慢的多步氧化还原动力学限制了其实用化。可锚定多硫化物并加快其转化的催化剂是一种被广泛研究的补救方案；该领域正从单金属催化剂转向由五种或更多主要元素构成的高熵催化剂（HECs）。本综述围绕电子描述符展开，主要是 d-band center 及其改进形式；这些描述符被用于将多元素组成与多硫化物吸附和反应势垒联系起来。我们定量定义构型熵，区分真正的 HECs 与低阶多金属催化剂，考察合金、氧化物、硫化物和单原子家族并关注机制和局限性，同时明确处理仍未得到充分证明的 RT Na-S 情形。随后，我们检视化学无序表面所需的一性原理工作流，以及机器学习（ML）新兴但大多尚未用于硫体系的应用。我们的核心结论是，d-band center 是有用但非普适的描述符；其预测价值取决于局部配位、氧化态、表面重构、溶剂化和多硫化物覆盖度，并且关于熵带来协同作用、以及尤其 RT Na-S 中高熵催化的直接证据，仍不完整。
items.author_line: Nusrat Jahan Hridita, Md. Safin Mahmood Shomyo

items.title: Self-organized mechanochemical instabilities drive the emergence of digit tissue morphogenesis
items.abstract_or_text: The emergence of complex anatomical structures -such as the hands- from unstructured tissues remains a fundamental question in developmental biology. Turing-type reaction-diffusion models have provided a molecular explanation for the periodic pre-patterning of digits; however, the physical principles driving 3D morphogenesis remain incompletely understood. To identify the biophysical design principles leading to digit formation, we develop a limb-mesenchymal organoid system that spontaneously forms elongated, digit-like protrusions. Iterations between experiments and agent-based models at the cellular level identify sufficient microscopic mechanisms leading to morphogenesis of digit-like structures: symmetry-breaking and the elongation of digits result from a combination of differential cell adhesion and morphogen-induced chemotaxis and convergent-extension. Lastly, to describe tissue-scale deformations, we perform a coarse-graining analysis of the agent-based model and derive a continuum model that reveals a structural analogy to Cahn-Hilliard-type equations. These equations are typically used to describe fluid phase separation and so-called ''fingering instabilities'' in fluid physics. Here, we show that they also accurately describe organoid morphogenesis. These findings suggest that ''finger'' formation is driven by a mechanical fingering instability acting in concert with chemical patterning, shedding a new light on vertebrate limb morphogenesis.
items.summary_zh: 研究在肢体间充质类器官中重建自发形成的指状突起，以细胞尺度 agent-based model 与实验迭代识别细胞黏附、趋化和会聚延伸机制，并推导与 Cahn-Hilliard 型方程相类比的连续模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把类器官实验、细胞级模型和组织尺度理论相连，为脊椎动物肢体形态发生提出力学—化学协同解释。模型给出的是“充分机制”而非唯一因果机制，向完整体内肢体发育的外推仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 复杂解剖结构——例如手——如何从无结构组织中出现，仍是发育生物学的一个基本问题。Turing 型反应—扩散模型为手指的周期性预模式提供了分子解释；然而，驱动三维形态发生的物理原理仍未被完全理解。为识别导致手指形成的生物物理设计原则，我们开发了一个可自发形成细长、类手指突起的肢体间充质类器官系统。通过在细胞水平上迭代实验和基于主体的模型，我们识别出导致类手指结构形态发生的充分微观机制：对称性破缺和手指延长源自差异性细胞黏附、形态原诱导的趋化以及会聚延伸的组合。最后，为描述组织尺度的形变，我们对基于主体的模型进行粗粒化分析，并推导出一个连续模型，揭示其与 Cahn-Hilliard 型方程的结构类比。这些方程通常用于描述流体相分离和流体物理中的所谓“指状不稳定性”。本文表明，它们也能准确描述类器官形态发生。这些发现提示，“手指”形成由一种与化学模式形成协同作用的机械指状不稳定性驱动，为脊椎动物肢体形态发生带来新的认识。
items.author_line: Tsutsumi, R., Diez, A. N., Plunder, S., Kimura, R., Oki, S., Takizawa, K., Nakano, R., Akiyama, H., Takada, R., Takada, S., Musy, M., Sharpe, J., Eiraku, M.

items.title: SemVac: A Semantic Vaccinology Paradigm Powered by LLMs for Antigen Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Reverse vaccinology identifies vaccine antigens from pathogen genomes, yet existing methods rely mainly on sequence and structure and overlook the functional and immunological knowledge recorded in the published literature. We introduce semantic vaccinology, a paradigm in which large language models (LLMs) reason over literature-derived protein descriptions to predict protective antigens. Implemented as SemVac, the workflow retrieves publications linked to each protein through PaperBLAST, condenses the evidence into a structured semantic profile, and prompts an LLM to return an antigenicity probability. Benchmarked against a curated 246-protein bacterial benchmark and the specialized protein-language and geometric-deep-learning predictor PLGDL, the best of 14 general-purpose LLMs matched or exceeded the precision of PLGDL; the open-weight Kimi K2 0905 offered the strongest performance-cost balance. Predictions were robust to masking of vaccine keywords, reproducible across repeated inference, and generalized to a 1,200-protein cross-pathogen dataset. Surprisingly, explicit chain-of-thought reasoning increased recall but lowered precision in every model tested, revealing over-reasoning in biological scoring. Applied to the mpox virus proteome, SemVac recovered the established mpox antigen repertoire and prioritized uncharacterized candidates. Two of these, A30L and C19L, received independent experimental support in recent orthopoxvirus vaccine development, providing external validation. For one candidate, B20R, the model generated a coherent but false TNF-decoy narrative unsupported by curated annotations, demonstrating that LLM confabulation can be detected when reasoning traces are cross-checked against curated resources. Semantic vaccinology therefore establishes the literature as an explicit, auditable third modality alongside sequence and structure, while making its failure modes transparent and correctable.
items.summary_zh: SemVac 通过 PaperBLAST 检索蛋白关联文献，凝练为结构化语义档案并提示 LLM 输出抗原性概率；在细菌基准和跨病原体数据集上比较 14 个通用 LLM，并以 mpox 蛋白质组和后续实验支持考察候选物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将可审计文献证据作为序列和结构之外的第三种抗原发现模态，并主动报告链式推理降低精确率及 B20R 虚构叙事等失败模式。它依赖文献覆盖与 LLM 输出，候选优先级不能代替免疫原性实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 反向疫苗学从病原体基因组中识别疫苗抗原，但现有方法主要依赖序列和结构，并忽略已发表文献中记录的功能和免疫学知识。我们引入语义疫苗学：一种大型语言模型（LLMs）对文献衍生的蛋白描述进行推理以预测保护性抗原的范式。该工作流以 SemVac 实现：通过 PaperBLAST 检索与每种蛋白关联的出版物，将证据浓缩为结构化语义档案，并提示 LLM 返回抗原性概率。在一个精选的 246 蛋白细菌基准以及专用的蛋白语言和几何深度学习预测器 PLGDL 上进行基准测试时，14 个通用 LLMs 中性能最好的模型达到或超过了 PLGDL 的精确率；开放权重的 Kimi K2 0905 提供了最佳的性能—成本平衡。对疫苗关键词的屏蔽表明预测具有稳健性，重复推理中结果可复现，并能泛化到一个包含 1,200 种蛋白的跨病原体数据集。令人意外的是，显式链式思维推理在每个测试模型中都提高了召回率却降低了精确率，揭示了生物学评分中的过度推理。应用于 mpox virus 蛋白质组时，SemVac 找回了已确立的 mpox 抗原谱并对未表征候选物进行了优先排序。其中两个候选物 A30L 和 C19L 在近期 orthopoxvirus 疫苗开发中获得独立实验支持，提供了外部验证。对于一个候选物 B20R，该模型生成了一个与精选注释不相符、但连贯的错误 TNF-decoy 叙事，表明当将推理轨迹与精选资源交叉核对时可以检测到 LLM 幻觉。因此，语义疫苗学将文献确立为与序列和结构并列的显式、可审计的第三模态，同时使其失效模式透明且可纠正。

items.title: Interaction Profiles as a Universal Language for Generative Molecular Design with ShEPhERD-2
items.abstract_or_text: Three-dimensional intermolecular interactions govern molecular recognition and are fundamental to the pharmacological activity of small-molecule drugs. We propose that an interaction profile, comprising shape, electrostatics, and directional pharmacophores, is a sufficient and transferable design specification for molecular design. We introduce ShEPhERD-2, a 3D generative model that generates molecular structures conditioned on explicit interaction profiles. ShEPhERD-2 generates low-strain, drug-like molecules more efficiently and with greater fidelity to target interaction profiles than its predecessor while enabling precise control over molecular design through pharmacophore prioritization, substructure constraints, and composition of multiple interaction profiles. We demonstrate the application of a single model to bioisosteric fragment merging, dual-target design, selectivity engineering, and modality hopping without task-specific retraining. These results establish interaction profiles as a chemotype-agnostic interface between structure hypotheses and molecular design.
items.summary_zh: ShEPhERD-2 以形状、静电和定向药效团组成的 interaction profile 为条件，进行三维分子生成；摘要报告该模型支持药效团优先级、子结构约束及多个 interaction profile 组合，并可用于多个设计任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以可迁移的相互作用规格连接结构假设与生成设计，有望减少每项药物设计任务单独训练模型的需求。摘要中的优势主要是生成和几何/药物样性指标，尚未提供实验结合或药效验证。
items.abstract_zh: 三维分子间相互作用支配分子识别，并且是小分子药物药理活性的基础。我们提出，由形状、静电和定向药效团组成的 interaction profile，是分子设计中充分且可迁移的设计规格。我们引入 ShEPhERD-2，这是一个以显式 interaction profile 为条件生成分子结构的三维生成模型。与其前身相比，ShEPhERD-2 能更高效地生成低应变、类药分子，并以更高保真度符合目标 interaction profile；同时通过药效团优先级、子结构约束和多个 interaction profile 的组合，实现对分子设计的精确控制。我们展示了单一模型在生物电子等排体片段合并、双靶点设计、选择性工程和模态跃迁中的应用，无需任务特异性再训练。这些结果将 interaction profile 确立为结构假设与分子设计之间不依赖 chemotype 的接口。
items.author_line: Abeywardane, K. A., Walker, K., Coley, C. W.

items.title: Comparative transcriptomic analysis reveals conserved injury responses and divergent molecular responses underlying early regenerative competence following traumatic brain injury
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a leading cause of mortality and long term neurological disability worldwide. Adult mammals have limited regenerative capacity following central nervous system (CNS) injury, but zebrafish have a remarkable regenerative potential, providing an opportunity to identify molecular mechanisms associated with successful CNS repair. Methods: We have integrated publicly available acute phase TBI transcriptomic datasets from human, mouse, rat, and zebrafish studies published up to April 2026. Differential expression data were combined using restricted maximum likelihood (REML) based random effects meta analysis to account for biological and technical heterogeneity. Following ortholog mapping, we compared conserved injury responses with transcriptional programmes preferentially enhanced in zebrafish. Results: The acute molecular response to TBI is largely conserved across vertebrate species with predominant activation of cell cycle regulation, chromosome segregation, and interferon-mediated immune signalling genes. A conserved injury-responsive gene set further highlighted enrichment of mitotic and JAK-STAT signalling. In contrast, 54 zebrafish-enhanced genes displayed preferential activation of wound healing, extracellular matrix remodelling, integrin mediated signalling, and regulated immune responses. Protein protein interaction analysis identified STAT1, STAT3, FN1, CD44, ANXA2, and AXL as central hub genes connecting these injury and repair associated responses. Conclusions: Our study suggest that successful CNS regeneration is not driven by unique injury pathways but rather by coordinated modulation of conserved injury responses and additional molecular programmes that promote tissue remodelling and repair. These regeneration associated networks provide potential targets for future functional studies and may contribute to the development of regenerative therapeutic strategies for traumatic brain injury.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 REML 随机效应 meta-analysis 整合截至 2026 年 4 月发表的人、小鼠、大鼠和斑马鱼急性期 TBI 转录组数据，区分脊椎动物保守损伤反应与斑马鱼增强的再生转录程序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨物种整合指出损伤本身的保守性，以及与成功 CNS 修复相关的组织重塑网络，为再生治疗假设提供候选靶点。结果是公开数据的观察性关联，不能证明这些 hub genes 在哺乳动物 TBI 再生中的因果作用。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：创伤性脑损伤（TBI）是全球死亡和长期神经功能障碍的主要原因。成年哺乳动物在中枢神经系统（CNS）损伤后的再生能力有限，但斑马鱼具有显著的再生潜力，为识别与成功 CNS 修复相关的分子机制提供了机会。方法：我们整合了截至 2026 年 4 月发表的人类、小鼠、大鼠和斑马鱼研究中公开可用的急性期 TBI 转录组数据集。采用基于限制最大似然（REML）的随机效应 meta-analysis 合并差异表达数据，以考虑生物学和技术异质性。经直系同源映射后，我们比较了保守损伤反应与在斑马鱼中优先增强的转录程序。结果：急性 TBI 的分子反应在脊椎动物间大体保守，主要激活细胞周期调控、染色体分离和干扰素介导的免疫信号基因。一个保守的损伤反应基因集进一步突出了有丝分裂和 JAK-STAT 信号的富集。相比之下，54 个斑马鱼增强基因表现出对伤口愈合、细胞外基质重塑、整合素介导信号和受调控免疫反应的优先激活。蛋白—蛋白相互作用分析确定 STAT1、STAT3、FN1、CD44、ANXA2 和 AXL 为连接这些损伤和修复相关反应的中心枢纽基因。结论：我们的研究提示，成功的 CNS 再生并非由独特的损伤通路驱动，而是由对保守损伤反应的协调调节，以及促进组织重塑和修复的额外分子程序所驱动。这些再生相关网络为未来功能研究提供潜在靶点，并可能促进创伤性脑损伤再生治疗策略的开发。

items.title: Heterogeneous graph neural networks with biological prior knowledge for interpretable drug repurposing in triple-negative breast cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Drug repurposing offers a cost-effective path to new therapies for triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), a subtype with limited targeted treatment options. We present PRECISION, a framework integrating transcription factor (TF) regulatory networks, protein-protein interactions, and drug-target edges into a heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) to identify TFs mediating drug sensitivity and prioritize repurposing candidates. The knowledge graph has 23,498 nodes and approximately 830,000 edges from CollecTRI, OmniPath and the PRISM screen. In a fair cell-line hold-out evaluation, the GNN matches ML baselines in global prediction (Pearson r = 0.76). Per-drug mechanistic attributions via Integrated Gradients on the trained GNN, replicated across three independent training seeds and robust to baseline choice (Spearman's rho = 0.94 between the mean and the random Gaussian baselines), highlight stress-response (CREB3L1), epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT; KLF8, ZEB1), stromal/TNBC-specific (AEBP1, MZF1), and epithelial (SPDEF) regulators as stable mediators of drug response. Multi-cohort validation in SCAN-B (n = 7,397), METABRIC (n = 1,979), and TCGA-BRCA (n = 1,072) shows that predicted drug sensitivity is associated with overall survival in 623 drugs in SCAN-B and 74 in METABRIC (FDR < 0.05). Fisher's meta-analysis identifies 551 drugs at FDR < 0.05, validated by positive controls paclitaxel (p_adj = 8.6x10-3), docetaxel (3.1x10-2), epirubicin (3.2x10-6), and talazoparib (1.4x10-4). Paired Wilcoxon tests in 39 AURORA-US patients with matched primary and metastatic samples confirm that 4 of the 10 IG-identified TFs (CREB3L1, KLF8, AEBP1, SPDEF) are significantly altered during metastatic progression after Bonferroni correction. An explicit rule applied to the PAM50-adjusted Cox multivariate results (penalizer = 0.1) selects seven candidates (osimertinib, saracatinib, erlotinib, brigatinib, pelitinib, entinostat, trametinib), revealing pharmacological convergence on the EGFR signaling axis.
items.summary_zh: PRECISION 将转录因子调控网络、蛋白—蛋白相互作用和药物—靶点边整合为异质图神经网络，用于识别三阴性乳腺癌药物敏感性介导转录因子并排序再利用候选物；摘要报告细胞系留出、多队列关联及配对样本验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将可解释图学习、药物反应和临床队列关联整合到 TNBC 再利用优先级中，并通过多随机种子检验归因稳定性。预测的生存关联和七个候选物仍非临床疗效证据，尤其需要前瞻性药理与患者验证。
items.abstract_zh: 药物再利用为三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）提供了通向新疗法的成本效益路径；TNBC 是一种靶向治疗选择有限的亚型。我们提出 PRECISION，一个将转录因子（TF）调控网络、蛋白—蛋白相互作用和药物—靶点边整合到异质图神经网络（GNN）中的框架，以识别介导药物敏感性的 TFs 并对再利用候选物排序。该知识图谱包含来自 CollecTRI、OmniPath 和 PRISM screen 的 23,498 个节点和约 830,000 条边。在公平的细胞系留出评估中，该 GNN 的整体预测与 ML 基线相当（Pearson r = 0.76）。对训练后 GNN 进行的逐药物机制归因，采用 Integrated Gradients，在三个独立训练种子间可复现，并且对基线选择稳健（均值基线与随机 Gaussian 基线之间的 Spearman's rho = 0.94）；结果突出显示应激反应（CREB3L1）、上皮—间质转化（EMT；KLF8、ZEB1）、基质/TNBC 特异性（AEBP1、MZF1）和上皮（SPDEF）调控因子是药物反应的稳定介导者。SCAN-B（n = 7,397）、METABRIC（n = 1,979）和 TCGA-BRCA（n = 1,072）的多队列验证显示，在 SCAN-B 中预测的药物敏感性与 623 种药物的总生存期相关，在 METABRIC 中与 74 种药物相关（FDR < 0.05）。Fisher's meta-analysis 在 FDR < 0.05 下识别出 551 种药物，并由阳性对照 paclitaxel（p_adj = 8.6x10-3）、docetaxel（3.1x10-2）、epirubicin（3.2x10-6）和 talazoparib（1.4x10-4）验证。在 39 名具有原发灶和转移灶配对样本的 AURORA-US 患者中，配对 Wilcoxon 检验确认 10 个由 IG 识别的 TFs 中有 4 个（CREB3L1、KLF8、AEBP1、SPDEF）在 Bonferroni 校正后于转移进展期间显著改变。应用于 PAM50 校正 Cox 多变量结果（penalizer = 0.1）的一条显式规则选择了七个候选物（osimertinib、saracatinib、erlotinib、brigatinib、pelitinib、entinostat、trametinib），揭示其药理学上汇聚于 EGFR 信号轴。

items.title: Genome-scale perturbation signatures from primary human CD4+ T cells improve genetics-based prioritization of immune drug targets
items.abstract_or_text: While human genetic evidence improves drug program success, target selection largely relies on associational features. Even functional features are mainly observational, capturing disease associations rather than the consequence of perturbing genes in the disease-relevant human cell type. To move beyond association, we present IGNITE (Immune Genomics and fuNctional Integration for Target Enrichment), a framework that prioritizes immune drug targets by integrating human genetic priors with features from genome-scale perturb-seq in 22 million primary human CD4+ T cells and polarized T-helper subset differential expression. IGNITE is a semi-supervised machine learning model that applies positive-unlabeled learning to approved immune targets, then ranks 19,502 protein-coding genes to prioritize new candidates. In 727 in-trial genes held out from training, functional genomics increased target enrichment among the top 50 nominations from 2.7- to 4.8-fold for immune trial targets at any phase, and from 4.5- to 5.9-fold for targets in Phase III. These performance gains were immune-specific, as IGNITE outperformed genetic comparators on predicting immune-exclusive targets but not on cardiac-exclusive targets. Using temporal validation with labels frozen in 2014, IGNITE outperformed the genetics-only model in ranking 134 genes that subsequently entered immune trials. The functional genomics layer also surfaced two novel, pharmacologically tractable candidates, ELOVL6 and RUVBL1, elevating their rankings from outside the top 1,000 into the top 50. These findings highlight that perturbational signatures in the disease-relevant human cell type harbor target-relevant signals beyond human genetics, offering a generalizable route to indication-specific prioritization as perturbation atlases expand. Full IGNITE scores are publicly available at https://ignite.eecs.umich.edu/
items.summary_zh: IGNITE 整合 2,200 万原代人 CD4+ T 细胞的 Perturb-seq 特征与人类遗传学先验，用于免疫药物靶点排序，并在时间冻结验证中优于仅遗传学模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模、疾病相关细胞类型的扰动数据为靶点优先级提供了超出关联性遗传特征的补充信息，但 ELOVL6 和 RUVBL1 仍是待验证候选。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管人类遗传学证据可提高药物项目的成功率，靶点选择在很大程度上仍依赖关联性特征。即使功能特征也主要是观察性的，捕捉的是疾病关联，而不是在疾病相关人类细胞类型中扰动基因的后果。为超越关联，我们提出 IGNITE（Immune Genomics and fuNctional Integration for Target Enrichment），这是一个通过整合人类遗传学先验与来自 2,200 万个原代人 CD4+ T 细胞的全基因组规模 Perturb-seq 以及极化 T-helper 亚群差异表达特征来优先排序免疫药物靶点的框架。IGNITE 是一个半监督机器学习模型，对已获批免疫靶点应用正例-未标记学习，随后对 19,502 个蛋白编码基因排序以优先确定新候选。在训练中留出的 727 个处于临床试验中的基因中，功能基因组学使任意阶段免疫试验靶点在前 50 项提名中的靶点富集从 2.7 倍提高到 4.8 倍，并使 Phase III 靶点的富集从 4.5 倍提高到 5.9 倍。这些性能增益具有免疫特异性：IGNITE 在预测仅限免疫系统的靶点时优于遗传学比较模型，但在预测仅限心脏的靶点时并非如此。采用标签冻结于 2014 年的时间验证时，IGNITE 在排序后来进入免疫试验的 134 个基因方面优于仅遗传学模型。功能基因组学层还提出了两个新的、具有药理学可操作性的候选 ELOVL6 和 RUVBL1，将它们的排名从前 1,000 名之外提升至前 50 名。这些发现强调，疾病相关人类细胞类型中的扰动特征包含超出人类遗传学的靶点相关信号；随着扰动图谱扩展，这为适应症特异性的优先排序提供了一条可推广的路径。完整 IGNITE 分数可在 https://ignite.eecs.umich.edu/ 获取。

items.title: Safety, Immunogenicity, Antibody Persistence, and Booster Responses of an Animal-Component-Free Vero Cell Rabies Vaccine: A Randomized, Active-Controlled Phase III Trial.
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Eliminating animal-source additives from vaccine manufacture may reduce dependence on variable biological raw materials and the theoretical risk of adventitious-agent or extraneous-protein contamination. This study aimed to assess the safety and immunogenicity of an animal-component-free, antibiotic-free, freeze-dried human rabies vaccine (Vero Cell) with the "Essen" regimen and boosted two doses in China. Methods 1,200 healthy participants aged 10–60 years were randomized into two groups to receive the test vaccine or a licensed freeze-dried human Rabies Vaccine (Vero Cell) with the five doses Essen regimen. Two prespecified test-vaccine subcohorts received two booster doses with 3 days interval at month 3 or month 12 after primary Essen regimen respectively. Blood samples for immunogenicity assessment were collected pre-vaccination, on day 7 and 14 following the first dose, and day 14 and months 3, 6, and 12 following the final dose of the primary regimen. Additionally, samples were obtained before (months 3 or 12 respectively) and after two doses booster regimen. Rabies virus-neutralizing antibody (RVNA) concentrations were measured by the rapid fluorescent focus inhibition test (RFFIT). Safety observation was conducted during 30 days after each vaccination. Serious adverse event (SAE) was conducted throughout all the observation period. Results Out of 1,200 randomized participants, 596 in the test group and 600 in the control group included in the final safety analysis (SS). The test vaccine induced a significantly higher early seroconversion rate and geometric mean concentration (GMC) at Day 7 post-first dose. By Day 14 post-first dose and post-primary series, both groups achieved 100% seroconversion and comparable peak GMCs, with non-inferiority of the two groups. Over the 12-month persistence period, seroconversion rates remained high to 98% in both groups, with GMCs declining in parallel. Following a two-dose booster, both test-vaccine subgroups achieved 100% seropositivity by Day 14 post-booster. The reported adverse reactions (ARs) were primarily mild. No vaccine-related SAEs reported throughout the whole study period. Overall, the test vaccine demonstrated comparable immunogenicity, sustained antibody persistence, and a similar safety profile to the control vaccine. Conclusion The animal-component-free test human rabies vaccine (Vero Cell) induced non-inferior immunogenicity to the licensed vaccine following the primary Essen regimen, maintained RVNA responses at least one year, elicited robust responses to two-dose boosting even after a prolonged interval to 12 months. It exhibited a acceptable safety profile all through the whole period. These pivotal data establish the clinical performance of a manufacturing platform that avoids animal-source additives. Trial Registration: Prior to enrollment, the trial was registered with the Drug Clinical Trial Registration and Information Disclosure Platform in China (Registration No.: CXSL2010236). At the time of study initiation, registration in an ICMJE-approved registry was not required in our country, and the investigators were unaware of the ICMJE requirement. After completion of participant enrollment and before data analysis, the trial was registered with the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (Registration No.: ChiCTR2400089683). Before preparation of this manuscript, the trial was retrospectively registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07672626). No changes were made to the primary outcome, eligibility criteria, or statistical analysis plan throughout these registration processes. We acknowledge that retrospective registration deviates from the ICMJE requirement for prospective registration and consider this a limitation of our study.
items.summary_zh: 一项 1,200 人随机、活性对照 Phase III 预印本显示，无动物源成分 Vero Cell 人用狂犬病疫苗的免疫原性不劣于对照，并报告一年抗体持续性和加强免疫反应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是入选项中临床证据最直接的研究之一，但研究注册为回顾性注册，且结果尚为预印本，不能替代正式监管或同行评议结论。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：从疫苗制造中去除动物源添加剂可能减少对可变生物原料的依赖，并降低外源因子或外来蛋白污染的理论风险。本研究旨在评估一种无动物源成分、无抗生素、冻干的人用狂犬病疫苗（Vero Cell）采用“Essen”程序及两剂加强免疫在中国的安全性和免疫原性。方法：将 1,200 名年龄 10–60 岁的健康参与者随机分为两组，接受试验疫苗或已获许可的冻干人用狂犬病疫苗（Vero Cell）的五剂 Essen 程序。两个预设的试验疫苗亚队列分别在初次 Essen 程序后第 3 个月或第 12 个月、间隔 3 天接受两剂加强免疫。于接种前、首剂后第 7 天和第 14 天、初次程序末剂后第 14 天及第 3、6 和 12 个月采集用于免疫原性评估的血液样本。此外，分别于加强程序前（第 3 或第 12 个月）和两剂加强程序后采集样本。采用快速荧光灶抑制试验（RFFIT）测定狂犬病病毒中和抗体（RVNA）浓度。每次接种后 30 天内进行安全性观察，整个观察期内监测严重不良事件（SAE）。结果：在 1,200 名随机受试者中，试验组 596 人、对照组 600 人纳入最终安全性分析（SS）。试验疫苗在首剂后第 7 天诱导出显著更高的早期血清转阳率和几何平均浓度（GMC）。至首剂后第 14 天及初次程序后，两组均达到 100% 血清转阳和可比的峰值 GMC，且两者具有非劣效性。在 12 个月持续期内，血清转阳率在两组中均维持在高达 98%，GMC 平行下降。两剂加强后，两个试验疫苗亚组均在加强后第 14 天达到 100% 血清阳性。报告的不良反应（AR）主要为轻度，整个研究期间未报告疫苗相关 SAE。总体而言，试验疫苗显示出与对照疫苗相当的免疫原性、持续的抗体持久性和相似的安全性特征。结论：无动物源成分的试验人用狂犬病疫苗（Vero Cell）在初次 Essen 程序后诱导的免疫原性不劣于已获许可疫苗，RVNA 应答至少维持一年，即使加强间隔延长至 12 个月后仍可对两剂加强产生强应答，并在整个期间显示出可接受的安全性特征。这些关键数据确立了避免动物源添加剂的制造平台的临床表现。试验注册：入组前，本研究已在中国药物临床试验登记与信息公示平台登记（登记号：CXSL2010236）。研究启动时，我国尚未要求在 ICMJE 认可的注册平台登记，研究者亦不了解 ICMJE 要求。参与者入组完成后、数据分析前，本研究在中国临床试验注册中心登记（登记号：ChiCTR2400089683）。在制备本稿前，本研究在 ClinicalTrials.gov 回顾性登记（NCT07672626）。在这些注册过程中，主要结局、入选标准或统计分析计划均未发生改变。我们承认回顾性注册偏离 ICMJE 的前瞻性注册要求，并将其视为本研究的局限性。

items.title: Transcriptome-wide mapping reveals a non-canonical RNA-dependent mechanism of platinum cancer drugs
items.abstract_or_text: Off-target interactions frequently compromise the clinical utility of anticancer agents by driving dose-limiting toxicity and therapeutic resistance. Although RNA has been predicted to be an off-target for numerous FDA-approved drugs, the extent and functional significance of RNA off-targeting among anticancer small molecules remain poorly understood. Using a systematic drug-binding screen, we identified cisplatin, a frontline chemotherapeutic that acts canonically through DNA adduct formation, as a prominent RNA binder. We employed cisplatin as a model compound to characterize the mechanistic basis and functional impact of RNA-small molecule off-targeting. To map transcriptome-wide cisplatin-RNA interactions, we developed PlatRNA-seq, a click-chemistry-enabled RNA-binding profiling platform. Genomic and functional analyses reveal that cisplatin preferentially accumulates at RNA G-quadruplex (rG4) structures near 5' transcript ends, inducing R-loop formation. Critically, we demonstrate that cisplatin cytotoxicity is partially mediated through RNA binding, revealing a noncanonical mechanism of action. Collectively, these findings illustrate the functional consequences of RNA-small-molecule off-targeting and provide a generalizable framework for investigating small-molecule-RNA interactions, opening new avenues for therapeutic innovation.
items.summary_zh: PlatRNA-seq 将顺铂的 RNA 结合定位到转录组范围，结果支持 RNA 结合可能部分介导其细胞毒性，并指向 rG4 与 R-loop 相关机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以系统筛选、click chemistry 和功能分析拓展了小分子 RNA 脱靶的研究工具箱；其机制解释仍需在更多模型和临床情境中检验。
items.abstract_zh: 脱靶相互作用常通过造成剂量限制性毒性和治疗耐药而损害抗癌药物的临床效用。尽管 RNA 已被预测为许多 FDA 批准药物的脱靶对象，抗癌小分子 RNA 脱靶的范围及功能意义仍知之甚少。利用系统性药物结合筛选，我们鉴定出顺铂——一种经典通过形成 DNA 加合物发挥作用的一线化疗药——是一个显著的 RNA 结合物。我们以顺铂为模型化合物，表征 RNA-小分子脱靶的机制基础和功能影响。为绘制转录组范围的顺铂-RNA 相互作用，我们开发了由 click chemistry 赋能的 RNA 结合分析平台 PlatRNA-seq。基因组和功能分析显示，顺铂优先聚集于转录本 5' 端附近的 RNA G-quadruplex（rG4）结构，并诱导 R-loop 形成。关键的是，我们证明顺铂细胞毒性部分由 RNA 结合介导，揭示了一种非经典作用机制。总体而言，这些发现说明了 RNA-小分子脱靶的功能后果，并提供了一个用于研究小分子-RNA 相互作用的可推广框架，为治疗创新开辟了新途径。

items.title: LucaCell: a sequence-centric foundation model for cross-species single-cell analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models have transformed transcriptomic analysis, yet most rely on fixed gene identifiers that limit transfer across species and data types. Here we present LucaCell, a sequence-centric foundation model that represents genes through pre-trained mRNA sequence embeddings rather than static gene annotations. Gene expression is discretized into bins and modeled with a Transformer encoder, enabling sequence-informed cell representation without a fixed gene-ID vocabulary. Pre-training on 85 million human and mouse single cells, LucaCell is evaluated on human, mouse and lemur gene expression profiles, human chromatin accessibility data, unaligned reads from more than 50 prokaryotic taxa, and five influenza A virus genomes. LucaCell enables manual-mapping-free cross-species cell type annotation and an alignment-free microbial embedding framework that simultaneously distinguishes bacterial species identity and intra-species physiological states. It also improves gene expression reconstruction by incorporating donor-specific exonic SNP information into mRNA sequence embeddings, and predicts cellular viral load across influenza A virus strains while highlighting infection-like transcriptional states in mock-infected cells. These results show that sequence-informed gene representation can improve the generalization of single-cell foundation models across species, data types, and predictive tasks.
items.summary_zh: LucaCell 用 mRNA 序列嵌入替代固定基因 ID，并以 8,500 万人和小鼠单细胞预训练，评估跨物种、跨组学和微生物任务的泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 序列中心的表示有望减少跨物种单细胞分析中的人工同源基因映射依赖；全部性能结论目前仍来自预印本中的任务评估。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型已改变转录组分析，但大多数模型依赖固定的基因标识符，这限制了其在物种和数据类型之间的迁移。本文提出 LucaCell，这是一个以序列为中心的基础模型：它通过预训练的 mRNA 序列嵌入而非静态基因注释来表示基因。基因表达被离散化为分箱，并由 Transformer 编码器建模，从而无需固定的基因 ID 词表即可实现包含序列信息的细胞表示。LucaCell 在 8,500 万个人和小鼠单细胞上预训练，并在人、小鼠和狐猴基因表达谱、人类染色质可及性数据、超过 50 个原核分类群的未比对 reads，以及 5 个甲型流感病毒基因组上进行评估。LucaCell 能够实现无需人工映射的跨物种细胞类型注释，并提供一个无需比对的微生物嵌入框架，可同时区分细菌物种身份和种内生理状态。它还通过将供体特异性的外显子 SNP 信息纳入 mRNA 序列嵌入来改善基因表达重建，并预测不同甲型流感病毒株中的细胞病毒载量，同时在 mock-infected 细胞中突出显示感染样转录状态。这些结果表明，包含序列信息的基因表示可改善单细胞基础模型在物种、数据类型和预测任务之间的泛化。

items.title: A foundation model learns the sequence and functional grammar of fully human heavy-chain-only antibodies
items.abstract_or_text: Antibody language models learn from large natural repertoires, but whether generic representations capture the constraints of specialized antibody formats remains unclear. We first characterized fully human heavy-chain-only antibodies (HCAbs) independently of HCAb-trained models. Source-aware comparisons with conventional human VH domains revealed a reproducible distributional shift localized predominantly to CDR1/2, CDR3 architecture and, where supported, a restricted framework region rather than widespread framework remodeling. These model-independent differences motivated repertoire-specific pretraining. We developed HCAbLM, to our knowledge the first foundation model pretrained specifically on a large-scale fully human HCAb repertoire, using 31.8 million sequences from 73 independently immunized HCAb mice. HCAbLM learned a region-selective sequence-compatibility prior distinct from conventional antibody language models, and its frozen representations transferred to experimentally measured SEC purity, HIC behavior and thermal stability in grouped internal validation and retrospective cross-project evaluation. These findings identify repertoire composition as an important biological design variable for foundation models of specialized antibody formats.
items.summary_zh: HCAbLM 在来自 73 只独立免疫 HCAb 小鼠的 3,180 万条全人源 HCAb 序列上预训练，并将冻结表示迁移至 SEC、HIC 和热稳定性实验测量。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把抗体库组成作为专用抗体基础模型的设计变量，并提供分组内部验证与跨项目回顾性评估；尚未证明其在前瞻性药物发现中的效用。
items.abstract_zh: 抗体语言模型从大型天然抗体库中学习，但通用表示能否捕捉专门抗体形式的约束仍不清楚。我们首先在不依赖 HCAb 训练模型的情况下表征全人源重链单域抗体（HCAbs）。与传统人源 VH 结构域进行的来源感知比较显示，可重复的分布偏移主要位于 CDR1/2、CDR3 架构，以及在证据支持时位于受限的框架区，而非广泛的框架区重塑。这些独立于模型的差异推动了抗体库特异性的预训练。我们开发了 HCAbLM，据我们所知，这是首个专门在大规模全人源 HCAb 抗体库上预训练的基础模型，使用了来自 73 只独立免疫 HCAb 小鼠的 3,180 万条序列。HCAbLM 学得了区别于传统抗体语言模型的区域选择性序列兼容性先验，其冻结表示可迁移至分组内部验证和回顾性跨项目评估中实验测得的 SEC 纯度、HIC 行为和热稳定性。这些发现表明，抗体库组成是专用抗体形式基础模型的重要生物学设计变量。

items.title: DiffGSP: reversing mRNA diffusion to unlock high-fidelity spatial transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics enables gene expression profiling within intact tissues while preserving spatial context, providing unprecedented insights into cellular organization and function. However, mRNA diffusion during tissue processing can cause transcripts originating from adjacent cells to be captured at a given spot. This spatial misalignment challenges a fundamental premise of spatial transcriptomics that measured gene expression faithfully corresponds to its spatial origin, thereby compromising spatial fidelity and potentially biasing biological interpretation. Here, we present DiffGSP, a physics-informed framework that integrates Fick's law with graph signal processing to explicitly model diffusion-induced distortions and recover the underlying spatial gene expression landscape. Comprehensive benchmarking across diverse datasets and evaluation metrics demonstrates the consistent ability of DiffGSP to restore spatial gene expression patterns. By computationally reversing diffusion-induced distortions, DiffGSP enables the discovery of fine anatomical structures in the mouse brain, spatially organized gene modules in the kidney, intratumoral heterogeneity in colorectal cancer, and tertiary lymphoid structures in lung adenocarcinoma. Built on a physically interpretable framework and broadly applicable to sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics technologies, DiffGSP improves the fidelity of spatial gene expression reconstruction and enables more reliable biological interpretation.
items.summary_zh: DiffGSP 将 Fick 定律与图信号处理结合，显式建模并计算逆转空间转录组制样中的 mRNA 扩散失真。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 物理可解释的校正框架可能降低空间错配对组织结构和肿瘤异质性解释的影响，但其效果仍以计算基准为主。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学可在保留空间背景的完整组织内对基因表达进行分析，为细胞组织和功能提供前所未有的洞见。然而，组织处理过程中的 mRNA 扩散可能使源自相邻细胞的转录本在给定 spot 被捕获。这种空间错配挑战了空间转录组测得的基因表达忠实对应其空间来源这一基本前提，损害空间保真度，并可能使生物学解释产生偏差。本文提出 DiffGSP，这是一个将 Fick 定律与图信号处理整合的物理信息框架，用于显式建模由扩散引起的失真并恢复潜在的空间基因表达图景。跨多样数据集和评价指标的综合基准显示，DiffGSP 能够持续恢复空间基因表达模式。通过计算逆转扩散诱导的失真，DiffGSP 可发现小鼠脑中的精细解剖结构、肾脏中空间组织化的基因模块、结直肠癌中的肿瘤内异质性以及肺腺癌中的三级淋巴结构。DiffGSP 建立在物理可解释框架上，且可广泛应用于基于测序的空间转录组技术，可提高空间基因表达重建的保真度并实现更可靠的生物学解释。
items.author_line: Liu, J., Sun, S., Xu, Y., Jiang, S., Cao, S., Li, G., Zhao, X., Liu, B.

items.title: Synthetic Echocardiograms from Diffusion Models in Rare Cardiovascular Disease
items.abstract_or_text: The limited availability of imaging data for uncommon cardiovascular phenotypes constrains the development of robust imaging models. We evaluated whether class-conditional diffusion models can generate synthetic transthoracic echocardiograms that improve downstream cardiac imaging tasks. The primary application was cardiac amyloidosis detection in a Duke University cohort using a two-step classifier, with external analyses using EchoNet-Dynamic for image-fidelity assessment and EchoNet-LVH for wall-thickness phenotype classification. The Duke cohort was partitioned at the patient-encounter level into 70\% training, 15\% validation, and 15\% test sets; generators were trained only on the training partition, augmentation levels were selected using validation AUROC, and final evaluation used held-out real test data. In the Duke all-view two-step analysis, adding synthetic images increased AUROC from 0.883 to 0.924, with an AUROC difference of 0.041 (95\% CI, 0.013--0.069); in EchoNet-LVH, AUROC increased from 0.832 to 0.864, with an AUROC difference of 0.032 (95\% CI, 0.021--0.044). Expert review found that synthetic images were sometimes difficult to identify as synthetic, but rated them lower for diagnostic adequacy. These findings suggest that diffusion-generated echocardiograms may provide a practical approach to augmenting limited training data for selected cardiac imaging tasks and motivate further evaluation across clinical settings.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以真实保留测试集评估类别条件扩散生成的超声心动图增广，在心脏淀粉样变检测和 EchoNet-LVH 中报告 AUROC 提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究采用患者就诊层级划分和真实图像测试集，提供了合成影像可能改善特定任务的证据；专家也认为合成图像诊断充分性较低，泛化仍待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 罕见心血管表型的影像数据有限，限制了稳健影像模型的开发。我们评估了类别条件扩散模型能否生成可改善下游心脏影像任务的合成经胸超声心动图。主要应用是在 Duke University 队列中利用两步分类器检测心脏淀粉样变，外部分析则使用 EchoNet-Dynamic 评估图像保真度，并使用 EchoNet-LVH 分类室壁厚度表型。Duke 队列按患者-就诊层级划分为 70% 训练集、15% 验证集和 15% 测试集；生成器仅在训练分区上训练，增广水平通过验证 AUROC 选择，最终评价使用保留的真实测试数据。在 Duke 全视图两步分析中，加入合成图像使 AUROC 从 0.883 提高至 0.924，AUROC 差值为 0.041（95% CI，0.013--0.069）；在 EchoNet-LVH 中，AUROC 从 0.832 提高至 0.864，AUROC 差值为 0.032（95% CI，0.021--0.044）。专家评审发现，合成图像有时难以被识别为合成图像，但其诊断充分性评分较低。这些发现表明，扩散模型生成的超声心动图可能为特定心脏影像任务中增广有限训练数据提供实用途径，并推动在不同临床环境中开展进一步评价。
items.author_line: Lyu, P., Henao, R., Kwee, L. C., Peng, F. Z., Vemulapalli, S., Shah, S. H., Khouri, M. G., Zhang, A.

items.title: Lifelong Invertebrate Chordate Central Nervous System Regeneration is Driven by a Migrating Pool of Conserved Neural Stem Cells Program
items.abstract_or_text: Adult central nervous systems (CNS) are generally constrained by limited cellular replacement. How regenerating organisms integrate structural maintenance with continuous, cyclic renewal remains unresolved. Here, we leverage the colonial chordate Botryllus schlosseri which completely resorbs and regenerates its entire CNS de novo weekly. Combining indexed single-cell sorting, Smart-seq3 sequencing, spatial mapping, and temporal deconvolution, our studies suggest that this continuous CNS renewal is mediated by an intrinsic pool of lineage-restricted neural stem cells. Single-cell analysis resolved a conserved SOX2/NOTCH1/NEUROG1 prospective progenitor continuum alongside mature excitability-defined neurons. Brain aging drives a phase-specific desynchronization of this regenerative program, inducing early hyper-activation followed by a sudden collapse. Finally, syngeneic transplantation and in vivo tracking show that neural-complex-derived cells persist after vascular delivery and localize to developing bud and neural-associated territories, with injury-associated accumulation near the neural gland. This work establishes a spatiotemporal framework for lifelong chordate CNS renewal and aging.
items.summary_zh: 研究结合单细胞、空间和移植追踪，描述 Botryllus schlosseri 周期性 CNS 再生中与 SOX2/NOTCH1/NEUROG1 相关的祖细胞连续谱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该脊索动物系统为研究长期 CNS 更新与衰老提供了具时空分辨率的模型；文中的驱动机制主要仍是实验支持的推断。
items.abstract_zh: 成年中枢神经系统（CNS）通常受限于有限的细胞替换。再生生物如何将结构维持与持续、周期性的更新整合起来仍未解决。本文利用群体脊索动物 Botryllus schlosseri；其整个 CNS 每周均会完全吸收并从头再生。结合索引单细胞分选、Smart-seq3 测序、空间定位和时间去卷积，我们的研究提示，这种持续 CNS 更新由一个内在的、谱系受限的神经干细胞池介导。单细胞分析解析出一个保守的 SOX2/NOTCH1/NEUROG1 前瞻性祖细胞连续谱，以及成熟的、由兴奋性特征定义的神经元。脑衰老驱动这一再生程序发生阶段特异性的去同步化，先引起早期过度激活，继而突然崩溃。最后，同基因移植和体内追踪显示，神经复合体来源的细胞在血管输送后持续存在，并定位于发育中的芽和神经相关区域；在损伤相关条件下，它们在神经腺附近积累。本工作为终生脊索动物 CNS 更新和衰老建立了一个时空框架。
items.author_line: Anselmi, C., Levy, T., Yu, J. C., Ishizuka, K. J., Palmeri, K. J., Liu, D. D., Sinha, R., Voskoboynik, Y., Corridori, C., Neff, N. F., Detweiler, A. M., Weissman, I. L., Martello, G., Voskoboynik, A.

items.title: scACORN: Context-engineered agent orchestration of specialized small language models for single-cell transcriptomic interpretation
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell atlases now exceed 66 million cells, but turning a ranked expression profile and a free-form biological question into a reliable, evidence-grounded answer remains unsolved. Scaling a single model does not resolve this, because single-cell interpretation is a heterogeneous family of tasks whose correct answer depends on tissue, cohort, perturbation and annotation resolution. Here we present scACORN, an agentic alternative to monolithic single-cell language models that combines specialized small language models with context-engineered agent orchestration for their selection and composition at inference time. Each expert is built in two stages: domain-aligned contrastive adaptation fits a pretrained cell-to-text backbone to the transcriptomic geometry of a target dataset, and geometry-preserving specialization learns question-conditioned biological completions without eroding that geometry. A fixed orchestrating language model agent then selects and combines experts under a natural-language playbook that is itself optimized from textual feedback, with no gradient updates to the orchestrator. Across 10 Tabula Sapiens tissues, domain alignment raised transfer macro-F1 from 0.36 to 0.64 and Recall@5 from 0.87 to 0.97; specialized experts reached 0.89 mean exact-match annotation accuracy; and playbook optimization reduced unsupported gene citations from 14.5% to 3.5%. Our findings support specialization and orchestration as complementary responses to the heterogeneity and evidentiary demands of single-cell analysis.
items.summary_zh: scACORN 以专用小语言模型和固定编排 LLM 解释单细胞转录组；在 10 个 Tabula Sapiens 组织中报告迁移与证据引用指标提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该设计将模型专门化与可审计回答的编排分开，直接面对单细胞问答的组织和队列异质性；指标仍需独立复现与生物学专家评估。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞图谱现在已超过 6,600 万个细胞，但如何将一个排序后的表达谱和一个自由形式的生物学问题转化为可靠、以证据为基础的回答仍未解决。扩展单一模型不能解决这一问题，因为单细胞解释是一类异质性任务，其正确答案取决于组织、队列、扰动和注释分辨率。本文提出 scACORN，这是一种相对于单体式单细胞语言模型的智能体替代方案；它将专用小语言模型与上下文工程化的智能体编排结合，用于在推理时选择和组合模型。每个专家分两阶段构建：领域对齐的对比适配将预训练 cell-to-text backbone 拟合到目标数据集的转录组几何结构，保留几何结构的专门化则学习问题条件化的生物学补全，同时不侵蚀该几何结构。固定的编排语言模型智能体随后在一个由文本反馈优化的自然语言 playbook 下选择和组合专家，且不对编排器进行梯度更新。在 10 个 Tabula Sapiens 组织中，领域对齐将迁移 macro-F1 从 0.36 提高到 0.64，并将 Recall@5 从 0.87 提高到 0.97；专门化专家达到 0.89 的平均精确匹配注释准确率；playbook 优化将缺乏支持的基因引用从 14.5% 降至 3.5%。我们的发现支持将专门化和编排视为应对单细胞分析异质性和证据需求的互补策略。
items.author_line: Rasti-Meymandi, A., Nahali, S., Paramithiotis, E., Cheung, A. M., Dolatabadi, E.

items.title: Multiphoton tomographic fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy -TomoFLIM
items.abstract_or_text: Fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy provides quantitative, concentration-independent contrast for probing molecular interactions, biochemical environments and cellular physiology. However, the requirement to acquire sufficient time-resolved photon statistics makes FLIM inherently slow, limiting its application to dynamic biological processes. In live-cell applications, including calcium signalling and vesicular trafficking, acquisition times can exceed the timescale of the underlying biology, causing temporal averaging, motion artefacts and loss of transient information. Methods that increase FLIM acquisition speed while preserving quantitative lifetime accuracy are therefore required. We report on a high-speed, compressive, multiphoton fluorescence lifetime imaging technique (TomoFLIM). Two-photon fluorescence is excited using a line focus projected tomographically across the sample, while time-tagged fluorescence is acquired using time-correlated single-photon counting. Time-resolved fluorescence data are reconstructed using Lucy-Richardson deconvolution followed by a computationally efficient centre-of-mass method lifetime estimator. In addition, TomoFLIM Net, a physics-informed neural-network, directly reconstructs fluorescence intensity and lifetime from compressed time-resolved tomographic data. TomoFLIM was benchmarked against raster-scanned fluorescence lifetime measurements using calibrated fluorescence lifetime beads and biological specimens. We demonstrate imaging at compression ratios exceeding 90%, with Pearson correlation coefficients above 80% relative to reference images. A raster-scanned FLIM dataset acquired in 60 s was reproduced using TomoFLIM in 3.75 s, representing a 16-fold increase in frame rate and equivalent reduction in accumulated dark counts. TomoFLIM Net recovered distinct experimental bead lifetime populations, demonstrating a direct route from compressed measurements to quantitative lifetime maps. TomoFLIM therefore offers significant potential for rapid live-cell imaging of dynamic biological processes, including deep within turbid biological specimens.
items.summary_zh: TomoFLIM 以压缩式双光子 FLIM 和物理信息神经网络重建寿命图，在基准中将 60 s 栅格扫描采集复现为 3.75 s。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法将光学采集与学习式重建结合，可能有利于动态活细胞成像；相关性与校准珠、样本基准并不等同于所有生物学场景下的定量准确性。
items.abstract_zh: 荧光寿命成像显微镜可提供与浓度无关的定量对比，用于探测分子相互作用、生化环境和细胞生理。然而，获取足够的时间分辨光子统计数据会使 FLIM 天生较慢，限制其应用于动态生物过程。在包括钙信号和囊泡运输在内的活细胞应用中，采集时间可能超过基础生物学过程的时间尺度，从而造成时间平均、运动伪影和瞬态信息丢失。因此，需要在保持定量寿命准确性的同时提高 FLIM 采集速度的方法。我们报道一种高速、压缩式、多光子荧光寿命成像技术（TomoFLIM）。使用投射到样本上的线焦点进行层析激发双光子荧光，同时用时间相关单光子计数采集时间标记荧光。时间分辨荧光数据通过 Lucy-Richardson 去卷积重建，随后使用计算效率高的质心方法寿命估计器。除此之外，物理信息神经网络 TomoFLIM Net 直接从压缩的时间分辨层析数据中重建荧光强度和寿命。TomoFLIM 以校准荧光寿命珠和生物学样本为对象，相对于栅格扫描荧光寿命测量进行基准测试。我们演示了压缩率超过 90% 的成像，相对于参考图像的 Pearson 相关系数高于 80%。以栅格扫描 FLIM 在 60 s 获得的数据集可由 TomoFLIM 在 3.75 s 重现，代表 16 倍的帧率提升和累积暗计数的等效降低。TomoFLIM Net 恢复了不同的实验珠寿命群体，展示了从压缩测量直接得到定量寿命图的路径。因此，TomoFLIM 在包括浑浊生物样本深部在内的动态生物过程中具有快速活细胞成像的显著潜力。
